read.thesis: Data centre orders up 300% with $8.5B record backlog and a $3B+ hyperscaler deal, but CSA price realisation lagged input-cost inflation and the segment margin guide was cut to about 19%.

utilisation.quote: just not enough to keep up with all the demand

capex.quote: We plan to begin customer deliveries from this site in the late summer of next year.

triggers.label: Data center orders up 300%
triggers.quote: Data center orders increased 300%, and year-to-date, data center orders have exceeded $3 billion

triggers.label: Resi price realisation low single-digit vs mid-single-digit expected
triggers.quote: We had last quarter expected mid-single digit pricing. We ended up realizing low single-digits.

triggers.label: CSA margin guide cut to ~19%
triggers.quote: The most notable change here is in CSA, where we now expect full-year operating margin of about 19%.

triggers.label: Fort Worth capacity doubles Americas commercial
triggers.quote: It's going to effectively more than double our capacity in the Americas, which we need.

guidance.quote: We now expect full-year sales to be nearly $24 billion, with organic growth of about 10%
This takes us to our adjusted EPS outlook of $2.85-$2.90 for the full year.
The most notable change here is in CSA, where we now expect full-year operating margin of about 19%.
we remain on track to deliver our full year commitment of $2 billion
we expect to deliver double-digit EPS growth this year

prior_guidance_check.metric: Adjusted operating profit, free cash flow, share repurchases

red_flags.label: $3.1B goodwill impairment in Climate Solutions Europe
red_flags.quote: I am obviously disappointed with the impairment

red_flags.label: Price realisation lagging input costs; $550-600M incremental headwind
red_flags.quote: The combination of positive but lower than expected price realization, increased input costs, and supply chain challenges put pressure on margins

evasions.quote: we are not ready on this call to talk about margins for next year
